summary: Turf Wars (Phase 2) + Clan founding-rule regression. Backend pytest 15/15 PASS (state shape, simulation progress over 35s, rally requires clan / 429 duplicate / rally chat msg, admin settings/capture/reset, tag rule length 3/4/5 + uniqueness 409 + name too short). Frontend E2E: no-clan-empty → open modal → validate submit-disabled matrix (tag<4 disabled, tag=4 enabled, tag input clamps to 4 uppercase A-Z0-9) → color swatch → found → Clan Hub shown. /my-dino?tab=map: live-map + map-offline-note + map-toggle-turf + turf-panel + turf-leaderboard all visible; 10 turf-zone-* markers, 10 turf-zone-rally-btn-* panel buttons, 10 turf-rally-* clickable map zones; rally button click succeeds (backend receipt + capture toasts visible).

integration_issues.issue: After clicking turf-zone-rally-btn, the [data-testid=turf-rally-active] banner did not appear within 2.5s in the automation run. The rally endpoint itself succeeded (verified via backend pytest) and toast fired; the panel banner depends on the next state refresh from useTurf.load() and can lag briefly. Not blocking, but consider optimistic setState of my_rally right after api.turfRally() resolves so the banner is immediate.

action_items: Optional: in useTurf.rally(), on success set my_rally optimistically (zone_id + seconds_left = data.seconds) so the [data-testid=turf-rally-active] banner shows immediately without waiting for /state refresh.
critical_code_review_comments: turfwars.py:_rally is a module-level in-memory dict — if uvicorn is restarted or scaled to >1 worker, rallies are lost / not shared. Fine for preview, but note before multi-worker deploys (move to Mongo TTL doc).
turfwars.py:_tick_count is a module global — same multi-worker caveat for the 60s notoriety income cadence (each worker would tick independently).

turfwars.py:_compute_presence simulation uses random.Random(f"{cid}:{window}") with `deploy_window`; if admin sets deploy_window<15 the code silently clamps to 15 (max(15,...)) — this is intentional but not surfaced in the admin UI/response.

turfwars.py:admin_capture forces owner but skips notoriety awarding? Actually it awards via _apply_capture which does the $inc — verified. No issue, just note that force-capture from admin also generates a clan chat message (may be undesirable if used for corrections; consider a silent=true flag).

Clans.jsx FoundModal: color palette is hard-coded [C08B5C, E11D48, F59E0B, 22C55E, 38BDF8, A855F7, EC4899, 7C3AED] but SettingsPanel uses <input type="color"> (full picker) — mild inconsistency; either allow free color on found or restrict edit to same 8 swatches.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all data-testids render + interactions work; rally-active banner timing is the only lag)

test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo → JWT (demo admin, user id 3c45966b9bbf4bf59035ebae8237faa4). urllib from python fails 403 on preview URL from container — call POST /api/auth/demo via page.evaluate(fetch(...)) instead.
seed_data_creation: Founded/disbanded TEST_-prefixed clans during pytest and Playwright runs. Final _disband ran; demo user should end without a clan. Rival AI clans ALBA/OBSD/CNBR seeded by turfwars.ensure_seed() persist (expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_turf.py — run with `-n 0` because pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope and this file assumes sequential shared state (founding, disband, single-token). Simulation test sleeps 35s; expect ~42s total. Preview URL blocks direct urllib POST /api/auth/demo (403 Cloudflare); from Playwright fetch works fine. Rally is in-memory keyed by clan_id — after any disband/refound, previous rally is orphaned harmlessly. Demo user starts with 10M amberium so founding_cost of 20k is trivial across many test runs.
